PC:-
1) Heard the learned counsel for the applicant and the learned APP for the State.

2) This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 591 of 2023,
registered with Bhosari MIDC police station, Pimpri Chinchwad, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273, 188 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3) (e),
30(2) (a) and 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
909-ABA-3567-23.
